name: Guide Titles
description: Rewrites programme titles in the guide by rule after each EPG refresh: moves the matchup into the title when the source puts only the sport there, turns "at" into "vs" and adds a sport emoji. Edits the source's own programmes in place and keeps the originals, so channels stay mapped to the real source and a rule that stops working leaves plain titles, never an empty guide.
author: johnschult

fields.label: Rules
fields.default:
